== Title ==
<span lang="ja">シールド・ドアを閉めなければ</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">「エコー基地ドッキング・ベイ」と最も内側のマーカー位置の境界に配備する。“夜間状態”では、「エコー基地ドッキング・ベイ」と他の位置（エコー基地を除く）の間での移動はできなくなる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「姫、今夜はもはや手の打ちようがありません。もうシールド・ドアを閉めなければ」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — The Shield Doors Must Be Closed.

'''Lore''' — Princess, nothing more can be done tonight. The shield doors must close now.

'''Game text''' — Deploy on the boundary between Echo Docking Bay and the innermost marker location. Under nighttime conditions, movement between Echo Docking Bay and other locations except Echo Base is not allowed.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed subtype is エフェクト. Lore addresses 姫, not “Your highness.” Game text deploys on the 境界 and excepts エコー基地, not “an Echo site.”<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-theshielddoorsmustbeclosed.gif|Original English face]], [[The Shield Doors Must Be Closed]].</ref>
